title: 第28章 它，是神兽？
novel_title: 伪装隐世仙族后，大佬疯狂跪舔我
content_zh:
没想到还没机会开口，自己就已经被小女娃身旁的侍女拿下，简直可怜得紧。

    要不是李归鸿那小子来得及时，他这太虚宗老祖的脸面估计今天就得丢光了。

    现在能喝到这杯茶水，全都是对他的补偿。

    道韵入体，一丝暖意融入经脉，游走在身体各处，往日那些在秘境中受的暗伤，在这股力量的滋养下，竟有了恢复的迹象。

    待这缕道韵彻底吸收完全，老祖发现自己似乎触到了突破大乘中期的那层屏障，再睁眼时，神色清明，世界在他眼中仿佛又有了一点新的变化。

    而他身旁的李归鸿则没有那么平静，一杯茶水下肚，蓦然吸收的道韵直接让他境界松动，当场开始冲击合体中期，其他人亦是纷纷打坐运功提升境界。

    只有微生璃月饮了一杯又一杯茶水之后，茫然看着满地团坐的众人。

    不是，怎么就喝了一杯茶水，他们的境界就开始提升了？

    那她前几天喝的都算什么，算自己能喝吗？

    “统子，我感觉我有点伤心了……”

    神识里，微生璃月满心悲泣，她想升个级怎么就这么难。

    光是从练气六层升到练气七层，差点将渡星槎吸干不说，自己还搭上90多万极品灵石。

    结果大师兄和二师姐他们喝了自己一杯茶水，一个个就开始突破，这很难评。

    “阿璃，凡成大事者，必定要比常人经历更多的磨难，相信我，你肯定是天赋比所有人都高，升级才会花费这么多资源。”

    自从发现自己测不出宿主的灵根资质，又见识过阿璃升级所需要消耗的灵气过后，装逼系统认定自己肯定绑了一个金大腿。

    要不然阿璃开成长礼包怎么能跟在系统宝库里淘东西一样，每次都开出一大堆好东西。

    “谢谢你统子，我知道你这是在安慰我，但是你放心，只要咱们俩好好努力装逼，不怕升级不上去。”

    反正微生璃月是发现了，她升级也没什么瓶颈，灵气够了自然而然就能上去。

    唯一比别人差的，可能就是需要的资源比他们多亿点点。

    但她是什么人，她可是装逼系统持有者，修仙界未来唯一装神。

    不就是区区资源，微生璃月不相信靠自己的装逼本事还弄不来。

    “好的阿璃，统子相信你能做到的。”
content_en:
Unexpectedly, before I had a chance to speak, I was already taken down by the maid next to the little girl. It was so pitiful.

If that boy Li Guihong hadn't arrived in time, the face of his Taixu Sect ancestor would have been lost today.

Being able to drink this cup of tea now is all compensation for him.

The Taoist rhyme enters the body, and a trace of warmth blends into the meridians and travels throughout the body. The hidden wounds suffered in the secret realm in the past have shown signs of recovery under the nourishment of this power.

After this ray of Taoist rhyme was completely absorbed, the ancestor found that he seemed to have touched the barrier that broke through the middle stage of Mahayana. When he opened his eyes again, his expression was clear, and the world seemed to have a new change in his eyes.

Li Guihong beside him was not so calm. After drinking a cup of tea, the Tao Yun he suddenly absorbed directly loosened his realm. He began to hit the middle stage of integration on the spot. Others also meditated to improve their realm.

Only Weisheng Liyue drank cup after cup of tea and looked blankly at the people sitting on the floor.

No, why did their realm begin to improve just after drinking a cup of tea?

So what did she drink in the past few days count? Does it count as something she can drink?

"Tongzi, I feel a little sad..."

In her consciousness, Weisheng Liyue was filled with tears, wondering why it was so difficult for her to upgrade to a higher level.

Just by rising from the sixth level of Qi training to the seventh level of Qi training, he almost sucked Du Xingcha dry, and he also had more than 900,000 top-quality spiritual stones.

As a result, the senior brother and the second senior sister began to make breakthroughs one by one after drinking their own cup of tea. This is difficult to comment on.

"Ali, anyone who achieves great things must go through more hardships than ordinary people. Believe me, you must be more talented than everyone else. That's why you spend so many resources to upgrade."

Ever since he discovered that he could not detect the host's spiritual root aptitude, and had seen the amount of spiritual energy that Ali needed to upgrade, the pretentious system concluded that he must have a golden thigh tied to him.

Otherwise, how could Ali open a growth gift package just like searching for things in the system treasure house, and get a lot of good things every time.

"Thank you, Tongzi. I know you are trying to comfort me, but don't worry, as long as we both work hard and show off, we won't be afraid of not being able to level up."

Anyway, Wei Sheng Liyue discovered it, and there is no bottleneck in her upgrade. She can naturally go up if she has enough spiritual energy.

The only thing that is worse than others is that it requires a few hundred million more resources than them.

But who is she? She is the holder of the pretending system and the only pretending god in the world of immortality in the future.

It's just a mere resource. Weisheng Liyue doesn't believe that she can't get it by relying on her own pretentiousness.

"Okay Ali, Tongzi believes you can do it."
